scope: Actual game + Chromium DOM, keyboard and localStorage; Gamepad API simulated and one explicit synthetic touch PointerEvent, no physical device validation. Existing diagnostics select authored Aubagne and collision/LOS-checked camera positions for LT aim and dispenser modal navigation; no dispenser stock/resources or weapons granted.
